origin.push: Original perf-gap-2026-11-14 XR/Lua/Python bytes; portable int64 C correction retained from the audited Windows reference.
origin.inplace: Equivalent XR and raw C for the exclusive-access decision model: 4096 elements, 20000 updates each; modulo 2^64 recurrence and checksum.
origin.platformCorrection: Windows long cannot represent the push sum. C uses int64_t values/sum and checked size_t growth. Original inplace signed-overflow UB is replaced by uint64_t arithmetic and memcpy for signed output.
origin.byteIdentity: Governed inputs are Git LF bytes on every checkout. Windows CRLF-only source hashes from the first local preparation are historical, not cross-platform identities.

push.thresholdSource: Task339 M2 managed values and current goal: native <= 1.3 C.

inplace.thresholdSource: Exclusive-access decision section 5.4: inplace updates <= 1.1 raw C; no runtime calls in the hot loop.
